description: Implement RFC 9670 (JMAP Sharing) method handlers. Defines SharingBackend trait (supertrait of JmapBackend). Registers 10 methods: Principal/get, Principal/changes, Principal/set, Principal/query, Principal/queryChanges, ShareNotification/get, ShareNotification/changes, ShareNotification/set (destroy-only — handler must enforce), ShareNotification/query, ShareNotification/queryChanges. Entry point: register_sharing_handlers(dispatcher, backend). Spec: RFC 9670. Pattern: follow jmap-mail-server handler layout (backend.rs, per-object modules, helpers.rs). Blocked by: jmap-sharing-types epic.
title: jmap-sharing-server: RFC 9670 method handlers
